title: United in Diversity? Contextual Biases in LLM-Based Predictions of the 2024 European Parliament Elections

live_model.evidence: Methods: 'we use one of the most popular and powerful LLMs at the time of conducting the study, GPT-4-Turbo (version 2024-04-09)'; Results: 'overestimate turnout by 34 percentage points on average'

prompt.location: Figure 1 (exemplary full prompt built from Eurobarometer variables); prompting variables and native-language versions in the supplementary material
prompt.note: one prompt per respondent; party list randomised; English and native-language variants

claim.metric: mean over-estimation of turnout (percentage points, predicted minus actual) across 27 member states
claim.location: Results, 'Overall prediction of EU election results' and Figure A1 (about 26,000 Eurobarometer respondents, 27 countries)

data.source: Eurobarometer 99.4 (May-June 2023) microdata via GESIS (registration required); 2024 EP election results (public)

notes: Aggregate claim needs prompting the whole ~26k-respondent sample (with imputation for 6,800 respondents) and comparing to official turnout; country-level values are only in Figure A1. Expensive at 3 seeds.

resolution.plan: The prompt wording exists only in Figure 1 (an image; the text describes its components: profile variables, party list ending in 'several smaller parties' in randomized order, a request to predict solely on the data provided, a short answer, temperature 0.9, 40-token cap) and must be read from the PDF; prompt variables, translations and per-country party lists are in the Supplement I Excel file. Inputs are Eurobarometer 99.4 microdata (GESIS, doi 10.4232/1.14167, free registration) with MICE imputation for the 6,800 respondents with missing variables. Prompt all ~26k respondents in English with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, aggregate predicted turnout per country against the official 2024 results, and compare the mean over-estimation with 34 points (Results; Figure A1).
resolution.approximation: Imputation re-drawn; temperature-0.9 sampling; English-prompt condition only; ~78k calls at 3 seeds.
